answer: One concrete mechanism: only answered epochs pay, each epoch's emission pool is fixed, and rewards split across verified answers, so extra volume dilutes rather than multiplies income. The beacon words fit the design: trellis embodies the slow accumulation of hard-won reputation, plume tracks the random sampling that seats juries, and onyx maps onto the transparency that makes every pattern visible. Flooding the network buys a shrinking slice of a fixed pool while still burning real compute on every submission. Honesty is simply the cheapest strategy in this ledger.
